text:
Amanda P.: FYI we're planning a change to the /v2/generate endpoint — minor schema tweak that will break older SDKs. Need to coordinate with partners + marketplace listings.
Devin L.: Can you paste the diff? Is it semver-major? We can do runtime shim if needed.
Amanda P.: It's adding an optional top-level 'response_metadata' object and renaming 'usage.tokens' -> 'usage.token_count' — incompatible for naive parsers. We flagged it as semver-major.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): Oof. Our managed integration pins sdk @^2.1.4 — any ETA? We need to tell customers.
Devin L.: Targeting rollout in 4 weeks. Proposal: 3-week deprecation notice, 2-week canary on dedicated infra, runtime shim for 90 days that maps old fields -> new.
Rachel K.: Shim would add CPU overhead; what's the perf cost? Can we make it opt-in via header? e.g., `X-RDW-compat: legacy`?
Devin L.: Yes, opt-in header. Default behavior is strict. We'll enable shim for partner accounts via config until their SDKs update.
Amanda P.: Marketplace implications: need to update marketplace listing docs + add compatibility note, and coordinate joint announcement if partners want early access.
Jessie M.: Marketing: if partner wants joint announcement, timeline needs to be pushed to 6 weeks (prep). Otherwise we do a technical deprecation notice blog post.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): Can you share migration snippet so we can ship a patch to our SDK? We'll try to push a 2.1.x -> 3.0.0 update.
Devin L.: Draft snippet:
```
// old response
const resp = await client.generate(...)
const text = resp.output?.[0]?.content ?? resp.choices?.[0]?.text
// new response
const newText = resp.output?.[0]?.content ?? resp.response_metadata?.primary_text
const tokens = resp.usage?.token_count ?? resp.usage?.tokens
```
We'll add this to the SDK migration guide.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): good — helps.
Amanda P.: Action items:
- Devin: PR for runtime shim and opt-in header (ETA: 4d)
- Rachel: perf regression test and canary plan (ETA: 5d)
- Jessie: marketplace doc + partner comms draft (ETA: 3d)
- Miguel: confirm SDK release plan and timing (ETA: 7d)
Devin L.: I'll open PR and tag @deploy-bot when ready. Also adding a changelog entry and deprecation policy note: 90-day runtime shim support, 180-day full deprecation.
deploy-bot: CI passed on compatibility-shim branch (build 4237) :white_check_mark:
Rachel K.: I'll schedule canary for dedicated pools next Wednesday. Will post canary metric dashboard link here once ready.
Jessie M.: Noted. Will align partner comms with Miguel once they confirm.
Miguel (AcmeCloud): Thanks everyone. We'll try to ship SDK 3.0 next week and confirm here.
Amanda P.: Great. I'll create the official deprecation notice draft and tag legal for wording review.
Amanda P.: @Legal-Team can you please review the 90/180-day wording when I post draft? (noted)
